messages:
maria_sales: OrionBank sent a follow-up on the SIG. They have 9 specific evidence asks around data residency, encryption-at-rest certs, pen test summaries, and segregation of duties docs. Can someone run the question-by-question pack? /cc @george_se @lina_sec
george_se: I can take the SIG mapping. Do we have approved redaction guidance for pen-test reports? We need to avoid exposing internal scan credentials.
lina_sec: Yes — redact IP addresses and internal hostnames; keep executive summary + remediation timeline. I'll prepare a redacted PDF and an index of redactions. Also will extract the controls mapping to SIG question IDs. ETA: 6 hours.
maria_sales: Good. Orion expects the package before their risk committee tomorrow noon. That's tight.
henry_orion_risk: For context: committee needs a one-pager per control with artifact links + attestation statements. They prefer doc-level signatures (pm/eng/security).
george_se: Understood. For encryption-at-rest Qs: we'll provide AES-256 at rest specs, the KMS integration doc (customer keys supported in Dedicated/Private), and a redacted cert from our FIPS HSM vendor. Lina, can you confirm we can share the vendor cert snippet?
lina_sec: We can share the vendor cert excerpt (not full HSM config). I'll attach hsm_vendor_cert_excerpt.pdf and a short attestation signed by me.
ops_bot: presigned-upload created -> https://uploads.redwood/s/efgh5678 (expires in 7 days) :package:
george_se: I'll assemble the SIG spreadsheet rows and include a column "attestation" with signer/email and a link to each artifact in the upload bucket. File will be ORION_SIG_DELIVERABLE_193220.zip.
maria_sales: Also include SOC2 report abstract (redacted) and the latest penetration-test exec summary. Don't include raw vuln lists.
lina_sec: Uploaded: soc2_redacted.pdf, pen_test_exec_summary_redacted.pdf, hsm_vendor_cert_excerpt.pdf, controls_map.csv -> https://uploads.redwood/s/efgh5678/ (README explains redactions). I stamped the attestation: "Lina Security, Head of Infosec" with date.
george_se: Adding those links to the xlsx now. For the pen-test Q: question asks for remediation timelines for any critical/high findings in past 12 months. I'll add a compact timeline (anon) and reference to pen_test_exec_summary_redacted.pdf.
henry_orion_risk: That should be fine. Also, can you confirm change control logs for the last 90 days for production infra? A few entries will suffice, redacted.
lina_sec: I exported change-control entries (redacted) as change_control_90d.csv and uploaded.
ops_bot: file uploaded -> ORION_SIG_DELIVERABLE_193220.zip (2.0MB) to https://uploads.redwood/s/efgh5678 (sha256: a1b2...c3d).
george_se: Done 1
 I posted the completed XLSX with per-question answers and artifact links; added Lina's attestation text in each relevant row.
maria_sales: Amazing. I'll draft the cover email to Henry and the committee and paste it here for sign-off.
henry_orion_risk: We'll review after lunch. If any gaps, we'll ping for clarifications. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
george_se: Quick note: included contact for SOC2 auditor if they want independent verification (email obfuscated in README).
lina_sec: Final check: all artifacts have redaction notes in the README and a checksum (sha256) for auditor validation.
maria_sales: Great work team 44d. I'll mark this as ready-to-send and schedule a short sync tomorrow at 11:15am PT.
